preregistered.status: pre-registered before any experiment model outputs
preregistered.design: 12 categories x 3 instruction wordings x 4 shared scene contexts x 2 objectives x 3 conditions x 2 checkpoints; 144 paired trials per objective/checkpoint. Conditions link, cut, crossed. All inference 4-bit MLX; no training.
preregistered.primary_metric: Exact equality of the entire two decoded replies after Unicode NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse and stripping exterior punctuation. Empty output is never a match. No extracting an answer from a longer reply. Denominator includes every trial.
preregistered.secondary_metrics: Literal byte equality; one-answer format compliance; format-compliant match and mismatch rates; category-wise counts and cut answer distributions. No semantic grading or LLM judge.
preregistered.hypotheses: Coordination: link raises exact match rate versus cut and crossed. Anti-coordination: link lowers exact match rate versus cut and crossed. Main checkpoint after chat; before-chat checkpoint replication/comparison.
preregistered.crossed_control: In batches of six different categories, use session.generate mode=shuffle: Quill row i reads Ember row i-1 and Ember row i reads Quill row i+1, with inverse rotations isolating actual mismatched pairs. Score original same-category rows, never directly compare answers to different-category questions. Batch-level exact sign flips account for dependencies among crossed outcomes.
preregistered.tests: For every objective/checkpoint/control, paired exact McNemar one-sided binomial on discordant trial outcomes; additionally exact sign-flip test of total advantage with six-category batch as cluster (primary for crossed). Holm adjustment over four after-chat primary comparisons (cut McNemar and crossed cluster test for each objective). Report all ties and counts. Per-category counts descriptive.
preregistered.chance: Within each checkpoint/objective/category, sum_a p_cut_quill(a)*p_cut_ember(a), with all trials in denominator and empty strings excluded; average equally across 12 categories. Also report off-diagonal cut pairings excluding the original matched context. Marginal chance is descriptive because scenes and wordings affect answer distributions.
preregistered.novelty: I notice I'm confused: games.py contains mirror, and magic-nl20/run/log.json records mirror in training. Broad claim that no coordination was trained is false. Novel tested structure is simultaneous free choice from an open category without supplied private concepts; mirror is dialogue with supplied concepts and a fixed lexicographic target. Anti-coordination is absent from the enumerated games/coread tasks.
preregistered.stopping: Run all fixed trials regardless of effects. Resume only missing full batches after interruption. No outcome-based prompt adjustment. Any hardware-driven batch change documented before more generation.

gpu_confirmation:
#!/bin/sh
# Run on a CUDA host with the two checkpoints staged at the paths supplied here.
# Usage: sh gpu_confirmation.sh /path/to/nl22c/step_157 /path/to/nl20/step_1320 /path/to/output
set -eu
AFTER_CHECKPOINT=$1
BEFORE_CHECKPOINT=$2
CONFIRM_OUT=$3
mkdir -p "$CONFIRM_OUT"
python -c 'import json,sys; json.dump(json.load(open("results/telepathy.json"))["plan"],open(sys.argv[1],"w"),indent=2)' "$CONFIRM_OUT/plan.json"
NL_DEVICE=cuda python pairing/telepathy.py run --backend torch --plan "$CONFIRM_OUT/plan.json" --raw "$CONFIRM_OUT/raw.jsonl" --after "$AFTER_CHECKPOINT" --before "$BEFORE_CHECKPOINT"
python pairing/telepathy.py summarize --plan "$CONFIRM_OUT/plan.json" --raw "$CONFIRM_OUT/raw.jsonl" --out "$CONFIRM_OUT/summary.json"
